title: Feature Engineering for Detecting Fake News

cues.zh: 這個例子會聚焦於兩個主要特徵。

cues.en: So let's talk about feature one.
cues.zh: 先談第一個特徵。

cues.zh: 我們會檢查假新聞常用的特定詞語是否出現，來看看資料集。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now let's talk about the second feature.
cues.zh: 接著談第二個特徵。

cues.en: We're going to assess the user's credibility.
cues.zh: 我們會評估新聞來源的可信度。

cues.en: So we're going to calculate the probability of a source publishing real or fake news based on the historical data or its track record.
cues.zh: 根據來源的歷史資料或過往紀錄，計算它發布真新聞或假新聞的機率。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Calculate features.

cues.zh: 對於指定新聞文章，分析標題是否包含預先定義的假新聞關鍵字。

cues.zh: 我們要計算假新聞的比例。

cues.zh: 接著是第四步。

cues.en: Weighted vector calculations.
cues.zh: 計算加權向量。

cues.en: So we are going to assign weight ratio to our features based on the relative importance.
cues.zh: 根據各項特徵的相對重要性，分配權重比例。

cues.en: So in this case we're going to assign ratio to filter one and filter two guys.
cues.zh: 也就是替特徵一與特徵二分配權重。

cues.en: There is no like specific formula to know like what will be the ideal ratio for feature one and filter two.
cues.zh: 並沒有特定公式，能直接判定這兩項特徵的理想權重比例。

cues.en: So it really depends on your specific case.
cues.zh: 這取決於你的具體情境。

cues.en: So if you believe that feature one is more important than feature two, then assign higher ratio to filter one or the exact opposite.
cues.zh: 如果認為特徵一比較重要，就給它較高權重；反之亦然。

cues.en: If you believe that feature two is more important than filter one, then just assign higher ratio to filter two.
cues.zh: 如果認為特徵二比較重要，就提高特徵二的權重。

cues.en: But in this case, I'm going to assume that filter one is as important as filter two.
cues.zh: 這裡假設特徵一與特徵二同樣重要。

So if you round that up it's going to be 0.62 right.

cues.en: Step number five predictions.

cues.en: So if the weighted sum of the features exceeds a predefined threshold for example 0.5 classify the news article as real otherwise classified as fake.
